name: wizard-frontend-boilerplate-pro
description: Scaffold production-ready frontend apps with Next.js, React, Vue, Nuxt, or SvelteKit. 7-phase interactive workflow: interview, version resolution, scaffold, OKLCH palette generation, 28 UI components, sidebar showcase with collapsible code snippets, and end-to-end verification. Light/dark mode, Tailwind v4, WCAG AA. Pairs with ui-ux-pro-max for enhanced component output.
